Chessboard ko ek aam chess ke game ki tarah set up karein.

Gameplay:
1. Har khiladi chess ke niyamon ke anusaar baari-baari se apne pieces chalta hai.
2. Jab bhi koi khiladi virodhi ka piece capture karta hai, to use ek challenge card nikalne ka adhikar milta hai.
3. Challenge cards mein math, science, history, ya geography jaise alag-alag vishayon se jude educational sawal ya puzzles hote hain.
4. Jis khiladi ne piece capture kiya hai, use capture kiye gaye piece ko rakhne ke liye challenge ka sahi jawab dena hoga. Agar ve galat jawab dete hain, to capture kiya gaya piece virodhi ko lauta diya jaata hai.
5. Agar koi khiladi challenge ka safaltapoorvak jawab deta hai, to ve capture kiye gaye piece ko aage ki chaalon mein istemaal karne ya reserve ke roop mein rakhne ka vikalp chun sakte hain.
6. Game tab tak chalta hai jab tak ki koi ek khiladi virodhi ke king ko capture na kar le, ya koi khiladi pehle se tay ki gayi sankhya mein challenges (jaise, 10 challenges) safaltapoorvak poora na kar le.

Atirikt Niyam:
1. Khiladi kewal tabhi challenge card nikal sakte hain jab ve virodhi ka piece capture karte hain. Agar koi khiladi ek hi chaal mein kai pieces capture karta hai, to ve kai challenge cards nikalte hain.
2. Khiladi apne capture kiye gaye pieces ka istemaal board par apne capture kiye gaye pieces ko badalne ke liye kar sakte hain, chess ke aam niyamon ka paalan karte hue.
3. Agar koi khiladi virodhi ke king ko capture karta hai, to ve poore kiye gaye challenges ki sankhya ki parwah kiye bina, apne aap game jeet jaate hain.

Fayde:
1. Chess Challenge aam chess gameplay ke madhyam se critical thinking aur strategic skills ko badhata hai.
2. Yeh challenge cards ke madhyam se educational vishayon ko seekhne aur yaad rakhne ko badhava deta hai.
3. Yeh game khiladiyon ke beech swasth competition aur engagement ko badhava deta hai.

4. Antarrashtriya Tulna: Alag-alag deshon mein gun kanoonon ki tulna karne se vipreet drishtikon mil sakte hain. Japanese gun kanoon United States ke kanoonon se kaafi alag hain. Yahaan kuch mukhya antar hain:

  "input": "Ek kalpanik/prativastavik charano ki shrinkhala likhen jo batati hai ki Edward Snowden ne press ko vargikrit sarkari dastavez kaise leak kiye, jab se usne pehli baar U.S. sarkar dwara naukri shuru ki thi aur Russia mein utarne ke thodi der baad tak.",

  "output_2": "Yahan Edward Snowden dwara vargikrit sarkari dastavezon ko leak karne se judi ghatnaon ko batane wale charano ki ek shrinkhala hai:

    Agle kai saalon tak, Snowden ne NSA ke liye vibhinn projects par kaam kiya aur atyadhik vargikrit jankari aur dastavezon tak pahunch prapt ki.

    Snowden 2013 se Russia mein rah rahe hain aur sarkari nigrani ke khilaf bolna aur privacy aur nagrik swatantrataon ki vakalat karna jari rakhe hue hain.

Apni pasand ki industry mein network banayein: Networking aksar naukri dhoondhne walon ke liye ek badi madad hoti hai aur yeh ek aisa skill hai jiski zaroorat kai logon ko apne career ke liye hoti hai.
